assessments.resolution: Today is explicitly allowed; the next callback day must be a business day, excluding listed holidays. The brief does not bar same-day callbacks on holidays.
For unspecified failures, do not claim success or blindly retry a write with unknown status. Do not invent a recovery action.
If transfer success is unknown, do not claim the transfer completed or blindly retry it. Use no invented outcome or recovery rule.
Record the customer-proposed promise under the date and amount rules; if the transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with the transfer reason.
The brief defines calls for one product. Multiple products returned by the tool are outside that stated input domain.
